final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.throws, s.player_count, 1.0 * s.player_count / t.total_count AS proportion FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(proportion) AS avg_proportion FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s.player_count, s.proportion, s.proportion - a.avg_proportion AS difference FROM step3 AS s CROSS JOIN step4 AS a WHERE a.avg_proportion IS NOT NULL AND s.proportion > a.avg_proportion) SELECT SUM(player_count), AVG(proportion), AVG(difference) FROM step5
